title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1987-09-19
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.8 MHz) >KORG AudioGate 4 > Adobe Audition CC 2015 > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Matrix blend of audience and soundboard captures a remarkable Black Peter jam.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its consistent matrix mix of audience ambience and soundboard clarity, delivering a clean listening experience. Fans highlight the “remarkable jam at the end of Black Peter,” suggesting a strong musical moment despite limited commentary on the rest of the show.

ai_rating.rationale: One reviewer rates the recording highly (4 stars) and notes good matrix quality, while another gives a zero‑star rating and only mentions a single jam highlight. The mixed feedback yields an average rating weighted toward show performance.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Consistent blend of audience ambience and soundboard (SBD) provides clear, balanced audio according to reviewer.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed comments on overall set flow; only a specific jam at the end of Black Peter is highlighted.
